title: Ordinary condensed Galois descent for global derived sections
statement:
Let $k$ be a field, $k^s/k$ a separable closure, $G=\operatorname{Aut}_k(k^s)$ with its Krull topology, and $X$ a qcqs $k$-scheme. Write $X^s=X\times_k k^s$. Let $R$ be a commutative condensed ring, $R_T=p_T^*R$, and use internal module categories and their ordinary unbounded derived categories [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring, sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients, sk-def-sfb-module-objects, sk-def-sfb-derived-categories]. Write $\mathcal A_G(R)$ for internal $R$-modules with the condensed $G$-action of [def-sfb-condensed-action-module]. The equivariant geometric section functor sends an $R_X$-module $M$ to the condensed $R$-module whose sections at a profinite set $P$ are $\Gamma(X^s\times P,M|_{X^s\times P})$, with the action induced by the $k$-descent of $M$; $X^s\times P$ denotes the inverse limit of finite disjoint copies of $X^s$ along finite quotients of $P$. Denote its ordinary total right derived functor by $\mathcal K_R:D(R_X)\to D(\mathcal A_G(R))$. The equivariant module category is Grothendieck abelian; its invariant-submodule functor has the ordinary total right derived functor $R\Gamma_G$. Evaluation at the one-point profinite set, followed by forgetting scalars, is denoted $\operatorname{ev}_*$. It is exact on condensed modules.

There is a canonical natural isomorphism of exact functors to $D(\mathbf{Ab})$
$$\delta_{R,M}:R\Gamma(X_{\mathrm{proet}},M)\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{ev}_* R\Gamma_G(\mathcal K_R(M)).$$
For a morphism $R\to R'$, an $R_X$-complex $M$, and an $R'_X$-complex $M'$, the isomorphisms commute with every morphism $M\to\operatorname{Res}M'$ and the corresponding geometric and invariant morphisms after scalar restriction. They are also compatible with shifts and distinguished triangles. The assertion is in the ordinary derived categories and does not replace derived internal-function bar terms by underived continuous cochains. No finite cohomological dimension of $G$ is assumed.
